expected_value_creation: make drift evidence and incident closure structurally auditable without depending on a provider or trusting signal volume
beneficiary: QIF operators, accountable decision makers, independent reviewers, and downstream affected stakeholders
supporting_evidence: NIST AI 800-4 identifies fragmented logging, drift detection, monitoring-method trust, and automated-versus-human monitoring as open challenges
Microsoft guidance requires end-to-end correlation and telemetry sufficient for incident reconstruction
success_criteria: signal identity, freshness, correlation, independence, and conflicts are explicit and verifiable
incident closure is blocked until post-demotion observations and human governance satisfy a deterministic closure policy
